# Feature: User account avatar (profile + lobby)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-14 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Nutzer laden ein Account-Profilbild über den Media-Optimizer hoch; ohne Bild erscheinen Initialen. In der Session-Lobby sehen alle Teilnehmer Avatar, Accountname und User-ID (Account-Identität primär; Charakter/Rolle secondary). Roadmap: Issue #682 (Stufe B) — agent-ready P1 feature.

## Preconditions
- Authenticated user (or Local Admin with real storage session for upload success path)
- Media optimizer profiles include `user-avatar`
- Migration `user_profiles` + bucket `user-avatars` applied
- Session lobby reachable with at least self on roster

## Happy Path
- [ ] Profil-Tab zeigt ohne Avatar einen Initialen-Kreis aus Account-Display-Name (≥44px Touch-Target für Upload)
- [ ] Datei wählen → sofort Preview → DE-Status (Optimize/Upload) mit `aria-live` → nach Erfolg Avatar im Profil; User-ID bleibt sichtbar
- [ ] Upload schreibt nur optimierten Payload (`alreadyOptimized: true`); kein Raw-Bypass
- [ ] Lobby-Roster (`data-session-lobby-member`) zeigt für Self und Peers: Avatar (oder Initialen), Accountname, User-ID; Charakter/Rolle secondary
- [ ] Batch-Load: ein `getProfilesByUserIds` pro Lobby-Refresh für alle Roster-User-IDs (Cardinality: once per roster refresh, not once per member network fan-out beyond batch)
- [ ] AU-CONTENT-WIDTH / Phone–Tablet–Desktop: Avatar + Name + ID ohne Clipping im Main-Pane

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Optimize/Upload-Fail → Toast/Hinweis; bestehendes `avatar_path` / Initialen unverändert
- [ ] Abort / Retry während Optimize; Race neues File während Optimize
- [ ] Fehlende Profile-Rows im Batch → Display-Fallback + Initialen, Lobby crasht nicht
- [ ] GM ohne `session_players`-Row erhält trotzdem Account-Profil-Felder
- [ ] Unsupported MIME / over-budget → Fail closed, kein silent Original
- [ ] Local Admin ohne Storage-Session → klarer DE-Fehler, kein False-Success

## Regression
- [ ] Character-Portrait Intake (`character-portrait`) unverändert
- [ ] Session-Lobby Join-Code / Cover-Pfad unverändert
- [ ] Layout Chrome Display-Name weiter auflösbar

## Adaptive UI (AU)
- Journey surface; AU-01 no horizontal overflow; AU-CONTENT-WIDTH; touch controls ≥44px
- Phone / Tablet / Desktop recomposition for profile avatar row + lobby roster row

## Security Coverage
- B-03 owner scope: `user_profiles` UPDATE/INSERT own row; storage path `{auth.uid()}/…`
- B-09 no client-trusted privileged fields: avatar_path never grants lobby membership
- F-03 / media: MIME magic-byte sniff + policy MIME; no silent original after optimize fail
- SC-01 IDOR: cannot write other users’ profile/avatar
- SC-02 whitelist validation: profileId `user-avatar` + MIME policy
- SC-03 rate limits: N/A — client storage upload via existing auth; not a new public cost API
- SC-06 no secrets in client/git
- Launch SC-04…SC-07: N/A — not a launch ticket

## Assumptions
- Signed URL strategy for `user-avatars`: createSignedUrl with long TTL (or public URL if bucket policy allows authenticated-read equivalent); document in Implementation Notes
- GIF: reject (image/webp|jpeg|png only) — smaller budget than character-portrait (maxEdge 768, targetBytes ~400KiB, maxUpload 5MiB)
- Display-name edit UI out of scope; resolve from profile.display_name → auth metadata → email local-part

## Implementation Notes
- Migration `081_user_profiles_and_avatars.sql`: `user_profiles` + bucket `user-avatars` (authenticated SELECT; own write); signup ensure + backfill
- Domain: `user-avatar` asset profile (maxEdge 768, target 400KiB, GIF reject); `resolveAccountDisplayName` / `initialsFromDisplayName`
- Infrastructure: `userProfileService` prepare/upload + `getProfilesByUserIds`; MIME sniff; signed URLs TTL 7d refreshed on load
- Profile: `AccountAvatarSection` via `useMediaOptimizeIntake` + `alreadyOptimized: true`
- Lobby: roster primary = account avatar/name/userId; character/role secondary; one batch per refresh
- Gate: `scripts/media-optimizer-user-avatar-check.mjs` wired in `test-gate`
- Display-name helpers asserted in `scripts/media-optimizer-user-avatar-check.mjs`
- Signed URL strategy: private bucket + `createSignedUrl` (7 days); peers resolve via stored `avatar_path`
